notes.title: Update notes for Dec 5
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

This release improves loading performance to reduce visual stutters when exploring. I hope you enjoy smooth experience :)

Ryan

notes.title: Update notes for Dec 3
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

This build has the following changes:

- Improved camera when player is blocked by terrain
- Added an option for full manual camera control
- A world map is now available
- Bug fixes

Have fun!
Ryan

notes.title: Update Notes for Nov 13
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, this release has improved camera controls for the mouse. I also fixed a bug where regions of the world do not load properly after completing the game. Thanks for pointing these issues out to me!

Ryan

notes.title: Update Notes for Nov 12 #2
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, thanks for all you amazing help resolving issues in the release. A minor update with the following

 Fixed world building in Winterspire Peak where players could get stuck
 Fixed issue where fire may block players in Heart of Souls

notes.title: Update Notes for Nov 12
notes.notes:
[olist]
 Increased deadzone in UI controls to elminate spurious controls players are experiencing
 Fixed a bug that may prevent your owl friend's dialogue from continuing
[/olist]

notes.title: Update notes for Nov 11
notes.notes: Fixed a bug that may cause players to get stuck in chasm in the first cave. Sorry about that!
